examples: The lobby was overcrowded with people.

meanings: A practitioner is a doctor.
examples: She made an appointment with the practitioner to treat her cough.

meanings: The provision of something is the act of giving it to people in need or want.
examples: That department is responsible for the provision of emergency supplies.

words.general_translation_vi: Lại làm đầy, cung cấp thêm, bổ sung
meanings: To replenish something means to make it full or complete again.
examples: We planted nearly one hundred seeds to replenish the garden after the fire.

words.general_translation_vi: Đảo ngược, lộn ngược, lộn (cái áo) lại
meanings: When a car reverses , it goes backwards.
examples: We reversed out of the parking place and then drove away.

meanings: When something is sterile , it is completely clean and free from germs.
examples: The hospital room looked quite sterile .

words.general_translation_vi: Đưa lên cấp bậc cao hơn, nâng cấp
meanings: To upgrade something means to improve it or make it more efficient.
examples: He upgraded to a real fancy car.

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể sống được (thai nhi, cây cối... )
meanings: When something is viable , it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.
examples: Her method of solving the math problem seemed viable .

words.general_translation_vi: Tự ý, tự nguyện, tự giác
meanings: When something is voluntary , it is done by choice but is not required.
examples: Many people attended the voluntary boat safety class.

meanings: An airway is the passage by which air reaches a person's lungs.
examples: Since he was sick, mucus would occasionally get stuck in his airway .

meanings: The Almighty is a name for a god in a religion.
examples: Before eating, they thanked the Almighty for their food.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự đến, sự tới, sự xuất hiện (của một sự việc gì quan trọng)
meanings: An advent is the arrival or beginning of an important person, thing, or event.
examples: During the advent of radio, very few programs actually played music.

meanings: A cycle is a series of events that go in a circle from the end back to the beginning again.
examples: They were caught in a cycle of poverty, lack of education, and unemployment.

meanings: If something is definitive , then it is the most official.
examples: This library has the definitive collection of books on ancient Egypt.

meanings: To equate one thing with another is to compare them and consider them very similar.
examples: She equated the man's messy appearance with a lack of responsibility.

meanings: To found something on an idea or principal is to base it on that idea.
examples: This is founded on the belief that all people are created equal.

words.general_translation_vi: Ý thức hệ, tư tưởng, hệ tư tưởng (của một giai cấp... ), lý tưởng
meanings: An ideology is a system of belief.
examples: Within the teachers' ideology , there was a belief in the value of parent participation.

meanings: To inhale means to take air or a smell into the lungs.
examples: The camper inhaled the cool and fresh mountain air and felt relaxed.

meanings: To invoke something is to mention it to support an argument or ask for help.
examples: Before going into battle, the soldier invoked the name of his god for protection.

meanings: If something is lunar , then it is related to the moon.
examples: During a lunar eclipse, Earth's shadow darkens the moon's surface.

words.general_translation_vi: Tính mới, tính mới lạ, tính lạ thường
meanings: A novelty is something that is new, original, or strange.
examples: Ice cream was a novelty for him since he rarely had any.

words.general_translation_vi: Không phải mốt, không còn mốt nữa, cổ lỗ sĩ, lỗi thời
meanings: If something is outmoded , then it is no longer in fashion or use.
examples: Black and white television sets are outmoded .

words.general_translation_vi: Cá nhân hoá (biến thành chuyện riêng tư)
meanings: To personalize something means to design it to meet a person's unique needs.
examples: He personalized the woman's exercises to give her a better workout.

words.general_translation_vi: Bệnh tinh thần, (thuộc) bệnh tâm thần
meanings: If something is psychiatric , then it is related to mental illness or its treatment.
examples: The doctor said the patient might have a psychiatric problem.

words.general_translation_vi: Bệnh học tinh thần, bệnh học tâm thần
meanings: Psychiatry is the study and treatment of mental illness.
examples: Studying psychiatry has taught me a lot about mental illness.

meanings: A reflex is an unconscious action in which a body part responds to an event.
examples: There was a reflex when the doctor hit his knee with a rubber hammer.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự chiếm lấy, sự chiếm đoạt, sự cướp lấy, sự nắm lấy
meanings: A seizure is a sudden condition in which the body loses control and shakes.
examples: Bright flashing lights can cause seizures in children.

words.general_translation_vi: Một khoảng thời gian dành cho công việc nào đó
meanings: A session is a meeting at a regular time in order to discuss and solve an issue.
examples: Every three months, the managers met in a session to discuss regional sales.

words.general_translation_vi: Đồ dùng, dụng cụ (chủ yếu là đồ dùng trong gia đình)
meanings: A utensil is a common tool or container.
examples: It seemed that a fork was the wrong utensil for trying to eat the soup.

meanings: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.
examples: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.

meanings: When food is appetizing , it looks and smells very good.
examples: The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.

meanings: When you assign work, you give that work to particular people.
examples: I was assigned the job of making sure everyone had plenty to drink.

meanings: A cavity is a hole or space in something.
examples: There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave, where an animal lived.

meanings: If something moves clockwise , it moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock.
examples: Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.

meanings: When circles or rings are concentric , they have the same center.
examples: The target was a series of concentric circles.

meanings: Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.
examples: Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.

meanings: When food is crisp , it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.
examples: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp , delicious potato chips.

meanings: Discord is disagreement or fighting.
examples: There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.

meanings: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.
examples: The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.

words.general_translation_vi: Khoản (ghi số... ), món (ghi trong đơn hàng... )
meanings: An item is a single separate piece.
examples: There were some items of clothing found at the crime scene.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự trao đổi lẫn nhau, sự thay thế lẫn nhau
meanings: An interchange of ideas between people is a discussion of each person's idea.
examples: There was an interchange of ideas between the groups.

words.general_translation_vi: Thuộc nhiều lãnh vực văn hoá khác nhau
meanings: When something is multicultural , it relates to many different cultures.
examples: Everyone was welcome to attend the multicultural celebration.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự bỏ sót, sự bỏ quên, sự bỏ đi
meanings: An omission is something that has been left out or not done.
examples: Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.

meanings: To oversee something means to make sure that it is being done properly.
examples: His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.

words.general_translation_vi: Đâm, chọc, chích, xuyên (bằng gai, bằng ghim... )
meanings: To pierce something means to make a hole in it using a sharp object.
examples: The arrow pierced the target in the very center.

words.general_translation_vi: Lựa chọn, chọn lọc, tuyển lựa
meanings: When you select something, you carefully choose it.
examples: They had to select textbooks for each class.

meanings: The structure involves the shape and organization of the parts of a building or group.
examples: There are big differences in family structure in different cultures.

meanings: Visual relates to seeing.
examples: The visual displays were very attractive.

meanings: When something is wavy , it is not straight but has a series of curves.
examples: The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.

meanings: Conversion is the act of changing something into a different state or form.
examples: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.

meanings: To cram things means to put them into a place that can barely contain them.
examples: He crammed all of his shirts into the top drawer of the dresser.

words.general_translation_vi: Hoãn, trì hoãn, để chậm lại
meanings: To defer means to arrange for an action to happen at a later time.
examples: The girl was very sleepy, so she chose to defer her bath until morning.

meanings: To export products means to sell them to other countries.
examples: The United States exports many cereals and grains.

meanings: Fumes are unhealthy smoke and gases that are made by fires or chemicals.
examples: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.

words.general_translation_vi: Thường, thường lệ, quen thuộc, thường dùng
meanings: When something is habitual , it is a behavior that a person usually does or has.
examples: The man was a habitual liar who was incapable of being honest with anyone.

words.general_translation_vi: Bào chữa, biện hộ, chứng minh là đúng
meanings: To justify something means to show or prove that it is necessary.
examples: The government tried to justify its decision to bring the country into a war.

meanings: We use notwithstanding when we want to show that, although something has been done, it is not enough. A similar term is "in spite of".
examples: Notwithstanding your objections, we have decided to move forward with the project.

meanings: Output is the amount of something that a person or thing produces.
examples: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory's output of products.

meanings: Overpopulation is the state of having too many people in an area.
examples: The organization is concerned with the overpopulation of the world.

words.general_translation_vi: Giấy môn bài, giấy đăng ký
meanings: A patent is a right to be the only person allowed to make or sell a new product.
examples: He quickly established a patent for his brilliant invention.

meanings: To penalize someone means to punish him or her.
examples: The team was penalized when they broke the rules.

meanings: Petroleum is a liquid natural resource from which many fuels are made.
examples: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.

meanings: A region is a large area of land usually based on some common feature.
examples: This is the wheat-growing region of the country.

meanings: A scrap of something is a small amount of it.
examples: Chris liked to use many scraps of paper when thinking up ideas.

meanings: A sector is a part of a country's economy in a specific type of industry.
examples: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector .

words.general_translation_vi: Ký (tên) vào bên dưới một văn kiện
meanings: To subscribe to something is to agree with it.
examples: She subscribed to the view that musical education should be kept in schools.

meanings: To subsist means to have the food, water, and money needed to stay alive.
examples: Some people are forced to subsist on only a few dollars a month.

meanings: To suspend something means to delay or stop it from happening for a while.
examples: The oil company suspended production until it was sure the factory was safe.

meanings: A synthesis is a combination of different ideas or styles.
examples: The band's music was a synthesis of many different musical genres.

words.general_translation_vi: Người biểu diễn leo dây, người biểu diễn nhào lộn
meanings: An acrobat is a person who entertains people by doing amazing physical things.
examples: There were acrobats at the circus that did impressive and complicated jumps.

meanings: Advocacy is the act of supporting or recommending something.
examples: Janine's strong advocacy for the event made people want to attend.

meanings: If something is communal , it involves a group of people.
examples: On the weekends, Theo and his son picked up trash in the communal park.

meanings: If something is fluid , it is smooth and moves gracefully.
examples: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm hài hoà, làm cân đối, làm hoà hợp
meanings: To harmonize means to make different things go well together.
examples: The sweet and sour flavors of the dish harmonized well and tasted great.

meanings: If someone is industrious , they work hard.
examples: Dennis was very industrious , so he never had problems finding a job.

words.general_translation_vi: Có tài phát minh, có tài sáng chế
meanings: When someone is inventive , they are good at creating new things.
examples: The inventive student built a robot to help her with her chores.

meanings: Mandarin is one of the two main Chinese languages.
examples: Although John's parents both spoke Mandarin , he could only speak English.

words.general_translation_vi: Vùng đô thị, khu vực đô thị rộng lớn
meanings: If something is metropolitan , it relates to a large city.
examples: After years of living on a farm, Rufu was finally moving to a metropolitan area.

meanings: To mimic something means to copy the way it sounds, moves, looks, etc.
examples: The hunter mimicked a duck's call and shot the two ducks that called back.

words.general_translation_vi: Sai lầm trong ý kiến, suy nghĩ
meanings: When something is misguided , it is based on bad judgment or wrong beliefs.
examples: The snake bit Molly during her misguided attempt to catch it.

meanings: To rehearse means to practice and prepare for a performance in front of people.
examples: Vick's band rehearsed all week before their first show.

words.general_translation_vi: Có tài xoay xở, tháo vát, nhiều thủ đoạn, nhiều tài vặt
meanings: A resourceful person is clever at using what resources they have.
examples: Because he was very resourceful , he could make most of the things he needed rather than buying them.

words.general_translation_vi: Khinh bỉ, khinh miệt, coi khinh
meanings: To scorn someone means to behave without respect toward them.
examples: The criminal was scorned by everyone in the community.

meanings: If something is sensory , it is related to the senses.
examples: Iris and Eric preferred the sensory thrill of watching movies in the theater.

meanings: A statute is a law that is official and has been written down.
examples: The new statute made it illegal to walk dogs in the park.

meanings: Technical skill requires good control of technique.
examples: Her technical skill was perfect.

meanings: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience doing something.
examples: Hank was the team veteran and had completed more races than anyone else.

meanings: A villain is an evil person who breaks the law or hurts others.
examples: The villain made off with half of my family's valuables.

meanings: A vine is a plant that has long, twisting stems and climbs upward.
examples: The branches of the trees were covered with vines .
